boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named NOBTS campus destinations documented by current institutional dining, chapel, orientation, handbook, and campus-guide sources.

cards.title: Leavell Chapel
cards.subtitle: Campus worship and semester gatherings
cards.notes: Check the chapel calendar before you go, then join an in-person Tuesday or Thursday service during the semester at 11 a.m.
cards.short_summary: The seminary’s scheduled chapel gathering place.
cards.evidence_claim: NOBTS invites people to chapel services on Tuesdays and Thursdays during the semester at 11:00 a.m.; its orientation schedule places worship and welcome in Leavell Chapel.
cards.source_title: Welcome to NOBTS and Leavell College Chapel
cards.access_notes: Service schedule is semester-specific; verify the current chapel calendar before visiting.

cards.title: John T. Christian Library
cards.subtitle: Map-listed academic resource
cards.notes: Use the library as a named study stop; check its services and access details with NOBTS before planning a longer research session.
cards.short_summary: A campus-map-listed library destination for academic work.
cards.evidence_claim: NOBTS’s campus guide identifies the John T. Christian Library as an academic building on the New Orleans campus.
cards.access_notes: Confirm visitor and borrowing access directly with the library.

cards.title: Luter Student Center
cards.subtitle: Student-center atrium and campus offices
cards.notes: Start in the atrium to orient yourself, then ask Student Life about current campus activities or use the listed student services.
cards.short_summary: The orientation venue for campus expos, games, and student support.
cards.evidence_claim: NOBTS’s Spring 2026 orientation schedules a campus expo, NOLA Expo, and game night in the Luter Student Center atrium, and directs students there for help.
cards.access_notes: Activities and offices vary by term; check current Student Life information.

cards.title: Cafe New Orleans
cards.subtitle: Inside the Luter Student Center
cards.notes: Use this Luter Student Center coffee-and-light-breakfast stop on a weekday, but check the day’s hours and chapel closure before heading over.
cards.short_summary: Campus café serving coffee, drinks, and light breakfast items.
cards.evidence_claim: NOBTS states that Cafe New Orleans is in the Luter Student Center and offers coffee, drinks, and light breakfast items on weekday mornings.
cards.access_notes: NOBTS lists opening at 7:30 a.m. on weekdays, varying evening hours, and Tuesday/Thursday chapel closures.

cards.title: Landrum Leavell Dining Hall
cards.subtitle: Main NOBTS cafeteria
cards.notes: Plan a weekday breakfast or lunch here when classes are in session; current offerings and any guest arrangements should be confirmed with dining.
cards.short_summary: The seminary’s main cafeteria and an orientation meal venue.
cards.evidence_claim: NOBTS identifies Landrum Leavell Dining Hall as its main cafeteria and lists breakfast and lunch for purchase Monday through Friday when classes are in session.
cards.access_notes: Service is tied to classes being in session; meals require purchase unless an event provides them.

cards.title: Martin Chapel
cards.subtitle: Named campus chapel venue
cards.notes: Look for scheduled programs before visiting; the 2026 orientation used Martin Chapel for a THRIVE-hosted date-night event for married couples.
cards.short_summary: A second named chapel venue used for scheduled campus programming.
cards.evidence_claim: NOBTS’s Spring 2026 orientation schedule places a THRIVE-hosted Date Night in Martin Chapel, and the campus guide lists Martin Chapel.
cards.access_notes: Access depends on scheduled events; the cited event was specifically for married couples.

cards.title: Bunyan Building
cards.subtitle: Classroom building
cards.notes: Use posted room locations to find classes or academic sessions; orientation assigned multiple graduate-program breakouts to Bunyan rooms.
cards.short_summary: A campus classroom building used for program sessions.
cards.evidence_claim: NOBTS’s Spring 2026 orientation scheduled breakout and degree-program sessions in Bunyan Building rooms 101–108.
cards.access_notes: Classrooms may be occupied or access-controlled outside scheduled sessions.

cards.title: REC Center
cards.subtitle: Campus recreation facility
cards.notes: Ask Student Life or the recreation coordinator about current recreation programming and facility access before making plans to use the center.
cards.short_summary: A named recreation destination in the NOBTS campus guide.
cards.evidence_claim: NOBTS’s campus guide lists the REC Center among campus housing and facilities, and the Student Handbook identifies a recreation coordinator in Student Life.
cards.access_notes: Confirm current facility hours, eligibility, and activity availability with Student Life.

cards.entity_name: Doris Kelley Showers of Blessings Building
cards.title: Campus Common Goods
cards.subtitle: Doris Kelley Showers of Blessings Building
cards.notes: Eligible on-campus students can check the current pantry windows and contact Student Life if they need grocery staples, household goods, or guidance.
cards.short_summary: The on-campus location of the Campus Common Goods resource.
cards.evidence_claim: The 2026–27 NOBTS Student Handbook says Campus Common Goods serves on-campus students from the Doris Kelley Showers of Blessings Building and lists pantry items and hours.
cards.source_title: NOBTS and Leavell College Student Handbook, 2026–27
cards.access_notes: For on-campus NOBTS and Leavell College students; handbook lists Monday 9–11 a.m. and Wednesday 4–6 p.m.

cards.title: Legacy Plaza
cards.subtitle: In front of Leavell Chapel
cards.notes: Walk through the plaza before or after a scheduled chapel event and read the commemorative bricks and pavers without treating the space as a drop-in venue.
cards.short_summary: A chapel-front plaza marked by commemorative bricks and a bronze seal.
cards.evidence_claim: NOBTS states that Legacy Plaza is in front of Leavell Chapel and receives Legacy Brick installations; premium pavers are placed beside its bronze seal.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor plaza; follow campus access and event guidance.
